name: Kobi
lede: Kobi is a moderate purplish pink carried in our library from a single web source, and who coined the name, or where it comes from, is undocumented.

sections.title: A name without a story
sections.body:
Our library records only Wikipedia as a source for the name Kobi and its hex value, #E79FC4; no older dictionary, plate or survey in our holdings carries it, and the word's origin is undocumented here [1]. Computed by ISCC-NBS block, it lands as a moderate purplish pink, 3.1 units from that block's center [1].

In the color graph, the nearest named neighbor is [[mallow-pink|Mallow Pink]], 3.0 units away, with [[amaranth-pink|Amaranth Pink]] close behind at 3.5, [[carnation-pink|Carnation Pink]] further out at 4.5, and [[orchid-crayola|Orchid (Crayola)]] at 4.7 [1].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: Our archive finds this pink in just 3 of 23,781 paintings, about 0.01 percent, as photographed, with the stricter within-painting lens finding it in 2, rarer than 82 percent of our named colors [2]. The one dated match on file is a 1910 work by Ernst Ludwig Kirchner [2]. These are matches on photographed, varnished canvases, not pigment identifications [2].
